snapshot.trait_overview: The INTJ-T description combines four preference themes: private processing, focused attention and lower-noise settings; attention to patterns, possibilities and deeper meaning; logic-based decision-making; and a preference for structure, planning and clear follow-through. The T variant adds more self-questioning, stronger stress awareness and a tendency to look for improvements rather than creating a separate personality type.
snapshot.career_advantage: One possible work pattern to check is building coherent plans and protecting progress that matters most. A Thinking preference does not establish planning skill.
snapshot.growth_weakness: INTJ-T Architect can get stuck in detached over-optimization.
snapshot.stress_answer: INTJ-T may become stressed when long-range systems thinking is blocked, rushed, misunderstood, or forced into a noisy environment without useful feedback. They may keep revisiting a concern even after the evidence is already good enough for the next step.
